title: Compliance.
officialText:
All incinerators and crematories shall be installed, altered and maintained in buildings in conformity with the
applicable provisions of the Administrative Code and the New York City Air Pollution Control Code.
SECTION MC 908
COOLING TOWERS, EVAPORATIVE
CONDENSERS AND FLUID COOLERS
